text: - **0069 — Explicit feature composition.** Kills `register_defaults()` as production app architecture. A production app's Rust composition root must *explicitly* install substrate, reusable Nostr protocol features, app-owned product features, shell capability contracts, then start. `nmp-defaults` may survive only as a reusable installer library — **never** owning seed follows, bootstrap relay brands, signer permission defaults, or onboarding/product policy. "A request from one downstream app is evidence, not permission" to add app-named helpers to NMP crates.
